card.name: Hedging words before a qualified claim
card.fires_on: Hedge or qualifier words such as sometimes, may not, might not, can or even, placed just before a claim that is limited or contradicted. Seen in general web prose.

modes.label: Sometimes / may not
modes.description: Hedging adverbs or modals that soften a statement about how often something is true.
modes.example: warning that men and women<< sometimes>> “bully” each other.

modes.label: Negated modal
modes.description: The word not after may or might, setting up a doubt about a claim.
modes.example: However, that might<< not>> be true, and a version that uses

modes.label: Other qualifier slots
modes.description: Words like from, even, or a comma that lead into a concession or limit.
modes.example: no society can say it's immune<< from>>," he said.
